name: Cypress Maze is Going to Die
source:
The mortal realm is breaking its own rules. People are dying wrong – or not at all. Restore Cypress Maze’s proper fate, and the Reaper Division might finally notice your potential.

[From [url=https://circussoup.itch.io/cypress]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
凡间正在打破它自己的规则。人们的死法是错误的——或者根本不是。恢复柏树迷宫应有的命运，收割者部门可能最终会注意到你的潜力。

[来自[url=https://circussoup.itch.io/cypress]Itch.io[/url]]
